therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: chemotherapy-naïve participants with unresectable or metastatic pancreatic cancer

safety_signals: Nausea (22/62 participants CS-1008 related, 31/62 gemcitabine related)
Fatigue (20/62 participants CS-1008 related, 22/62 gemcitabine related)
Anemia (8/62 participants CS-1008 related, 15/62 gemcitabine related)
Serious adverse events included anemia (4/62), abdominal pain (5/62), and infections
results.dose_information: CS-1008: 8mg/kg loading dose followed by 3mg/kg weekly; Gemcitabine: 1000mg/m²
